name: Polar

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED. Standard Webhooks spec (Svix-compatible): headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`. HMAC-SHA256 over `<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw body>`, base64, header value prefixed `v1,`. Timestamp IS signed. Gotcha PagoKit must encode: the webhook secret must be base64-decoded before use in manual verification (the SDKs do this internally). Retries: 10 attempts with exponential backoff, 10s timeout, endpoint auto-disabled after 10 consecutive non-2xx. IP allowlist available (3.134.238.10, 3.129.111.220, 52.15.118.168, 74.220.50.0/24, 74.220.58.0/24). Polar does NO

The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. credentials.note: UNKNOWN. Verified only that auth is a Bearer organization access token; the `polar_oat_`/`polar_pat_` prefixes commonly cited were NOT confirmed in the fetched docs. Webhook secret is a plain base64 string, no prefix.

fees.notes: VERIFIED from docs. Starter (free plan): 5% + $0.50. Pro ($20/mo): 3.8% + $0.40. Growth ($100/mo): 3.6% + $0.35. Scale ($400/mo): 3.4% + $0.30. Plus: non-US cards +1.5%; dispute $15 flat; payout via Stripe $2/mo active + 0.25% + $0.25 per withdrawal; cross-border FX 0.25% (EU) to 1% (elsewhere). Orgs created before 2026-05-27 grandfathered at 4% + $0.40. Transaction fees are NOT refunded on refund.

notes: The only MoR in this cluster with first-class usage-based billing AND a documented LLM-token ingestion strategy — i.e. the exact billing shape an AI app built with Claude Code needs, from a provider that also absorbs VAT/sales-tax liability. Open source, so the generated integration is inspectable.
SDKs: Node `@polar-sh/sdk` (+ framework adapters for Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, Hono), Python `polar-sdk`, and Better Auth / Convex community plugins. Official.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps paddle/dodo/creem on MoR; overlaps orb/metronome/lago on metered billing. Uniquely does both in one integration.
